title: Recipe 13: Use your own model key
titleZh: 方案13：使用自己的模型密钥
summary: The built-in Activity settings accept a compatible endpoint, model, and key. The key stays in runtime storage and is never exposed through records, page state, or model messages.
summaryZh: 内置 Activity 设置接受兼容端点、模型与密钥。密钥留在运行时存储中，不进入记录、页面状态或模型消息。

files.label: App.vue
files.roleZh: 持久化选择与可见状态

guide.title: A model connection is runtime configuration
guide.titleZh: 模型连接是运行时配置
intro: The page reports endpoint, model, persistence, and request status. It never serializes the key.
Open Activity, configure a compatible endpoint, send a request, and inspect both the real messages and the page state.
introZh: 页面报告端点、模型、持久策略与请求状态，但从不序列化密钥。
打开 Activity，配置兼容端点并发送请求，同时检查真实消息与页面状态。

steps.title: Choose a persistence boundary
steps.body: The page exposes memory and session choices. Session keeps the key in this tab; production hosts often use a same-origin gateway instead.
steps.bodyZh: 页面提供 memory 与 session 两种选择。session 只在当前标签页保留密钥；生产宿主更常用同源网关。

steps.title: Keep the secret out of page state
steps.body: State reports whether a key exists and where it persists, never the value itself.
steps.bodyZh: 状态只报告密钥是否存在、如何持久化，绝不报告值本身。

steps.title: Expose the runtime settings entry
steps.body: AgentDock mounts the built-in BYOK panel and a bounded debug view in Activity.
steps.bodyZh: AgentDock 在 Activity 中挂载内置 BYOK 面板与有界调试视图。

guide.note: This page does not contain a provider key. Enter your own compatible endpoint in Activity. The key is never added to model context.
guide.noteZh: 页面不包含供应商密钥。请在自己的 Activity 中填写兼容端点；密钥不会加入模型上下文。
